docs.title: E.commerce-kit
docs.text: This project was generated with Angular CLI version 18.2.21.

docs.title: Development server
docs.text: Run ng serve for a dev server. Navigate to http://localhost:4200/. The application will automatically reload if you change any of the source files.

docs.title: Code scaffolding
docs.text: Run ng generate component component-name to generate a new component. You can also use ng generate directive|pipe|service|class|guard|interface|enum|module.

docs.title: Build
docs.text: Run ng build to build the project. The build artifacts will be stored in the dist/ directory.

docs.title: Running unit tests
docs.text: Run ng test to execute the unit tests via Karma.

docs.title: Running end-to-end tests
docs.text: Run ng e2e to execute the end-to-end tests via a platform of your choice. To use this command, you need to first add a package that implements end-to-end testing capabilities.

docs.title: Further help
docs.text: To get more help on the Angular CLI use ng help or go check out the Angular CLI Overview and Command Reference page.
